package saga

import (
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/app"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestReviewRejectReceiptRetentionShorterThanRetryWindow(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := sagaTestConfig()
	cfg.Set("sid", 1)
	cfg.Set("server_type", "game")
	cfg.Set("saga.terminal_retention", time.Minute)
	cfg.Set("saga.receipt_retention", time.Minute)
	cfg.Set("saga.step_defaults.timeout", 10*time.Second)
	cfg.Set("saga.step_defaults.max_attempts", 10)
	cfg.Set("saga.step_defaults.backoff_min", 10*time.Second)
	cfg.Set("saga.step_defaults.backoff_max", 10*time.Second)
	if err := app.CheckConfig(cfg, NewMod(giftDefinition())); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("unsafe config accepted: receipt expires at 60s, operation retry budget is 190s")
	} else {
		t.Logf("rejected because: %v", err)
	}
}
